entry.title: News outlets featuring our E93 paper

link.title: News outlets featuring our E93 paper

entry.content:
Our recent publication in PNAS about the role of E93 in the embryo as key payer on the evolution of insect metamorphosis has been featured in different news outlets in Poland and Spain. Here are some of them.

In Spain:

  • La Vanguardia

  • SINC

  • La Sexta

In Poland:

  • Nawka w Polsce

  • TVP Krakow

  • Gazeta Krakowska

  • Radio Opole

  • Forum Akademickie

  • Esculap

  • MediaRoom

entry.title: New grant!!
entry.content:
We have been awarded a SONATA 17 grant of 1.3M PLN from the National Science Centre to undertake a project on the evolution and functional roles of piRNAs.

For this prokject, we will be recruiting PhDstudents and postdocs (bioinformatics and wet-lab)

entry.title: Hello World!
entry.content:
Hello world!

The Laboratory of Bioinformatics and Genome Biology is opening its doors on November 1st, 2021 at the Faculty of Biochemistry, Biophysics, and Biotechnology of Jagiellonian University.
